title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

You'll be joining a well-established and successful business in the Shrewsbury, who are looking for a Credit Controller to join its friendly Finance team on a permanent basis.

Your new role

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will manage your own sales ledger accounts and make sure customer payments are collected on time, while keeping positive working relationships with customers. Your duties will include:
- Monitoring customer accounts and outstanding balances
- Taking customer payments over the phone using an online payment portal
- Chasing overdue accounts by phone and email, and resolving payment queries
- Finding out why customers are paying late and agreeing to practical solutions
- Keeping bad debt within your accounts to a minimum
- Preparing aged debt reports and giving regular updates to management
- Working closely with internal colleagues to resolve outstanding issues
- Keeping accurate records of all credit control activity
- Supporting month-end and helping with financial reporting

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in credit control or accounts receivable would be ideal, but our client will also consider individuals from a customer service or accounting background who are interested in credit control
- A confident telephone manner and good negotiation skills
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Good organisation and time management, with excellent attention to detail
- Good Microsoft Excel skills and experience of accounting systems
- The ability to work on your own initiative and meet collection targets

What you'll get in return

You'll join a friendly, supportive Finance team based in modern offices in an easily accessible part of Shrewsbury, with free on-site parking. You'll work excellent hours, 9am to 5pm Monday to Friday, with a half-hour lunch and get 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays. This is a great opportunity for a Credit Controller to join a stable, well-established business and build a long-term career.
What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Robert Half is delighted to be recruiting for a Finance Assistant on behalf of a fast-growing and ambitious business based in Telford. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking to join a busy and collaborative finance team within a dynamic environment.

This role will initially be offered on a temporary basis with the opportunity to become permanent for the successful candidate.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, the Finance Assistant will support the day-to-day running of the finance function, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and deadlines are met.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing purchase invoices and matching them to purchase orders
- Raising and processing sales invoices
- Managing supplier statement reconciliations
- Assisting with payment runs and supplier payments
- Posting cash receipts and allocating customer payments
- Bank reconciliations and investigation of discrepancies
- Maintaining accurate customer and supplier accounts
- Supporting credit control activities and chasing outstanding debt
- Resolving invoice, payment and account queries
- Assisting with month-end processes, including accruals and prepayments
- Preparing finance reports and spreadsheets as required
- Maintaining finance records and ensuring data accuracy
- Supporting audits and compliance activities
- Assisting with ad hoc finance and administrative duties

About You
- Previous experience within a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
- Experience with reconciliations and high-volume transaction processing
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively
- Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- AAT study or qualification would be advantageous but not essential

What's on Offer
- Temp-to-perm opportunity with long-term career prospects
- Join a supportive and growing finance team
- Full-time office-based role in Telford
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Opportunity to develop skills and progress within the finance function

title: Purchase Ledger
description:
About the Business

A fantastic opportunity to join a well-established public sector organisation based in Shrewsbury as a Purchase Ledger Assistant, paying £26,000 - £28,000 per annum. This is a 6-month temp to perm role, giving you a clear route into a permanent position. You'll take real ownership of the purchase ledger and utility accounts, working in a close-knit, supportive finance team where accuracy and good supplier relationships really matter.

Main Duties:

As a Purchase Ledger Assistant, your main duties include:
- Processing invoices and credit notes from suppliers, checking each one against the relevant purchase order and delivery paperwork before it is posted
- Allocating costs to the right budget and nominal codes, applying the correct VAT treatment every time
- Sending invoices to the appropriate budget holders for sign-off, making sure approval limits and financial procedures are followed
- Running the weekly and monthly BACS payment cycles, making sure every supplier is paid correctly and on schedule
- Creating new supplier accounts and keeping existing records up to date, carrying out thorough checks on any bank detail changes to protect against fraud
- Raising sales invoices and recharges to partner organisations and other parties where costs need to be recovered
- Being the go-to contact for suppliers over the phone and by email, resolving their queries quickly and courteously
- Looking into missing, duplicated or disputed invoices and following up on outstanding credit notes
- Reconciling monthly statements from suppliers against the ledger and clearing any differences
- Reviewing gas, electricity and water bills for accuracy, comparing them with meter readings, tariffs and agreed contract rates
- Tracking usage and spend across properties, shared spaces and offices, spotting trends and anything out of the ordinary

Location / Office / Culture

The role is hybrid, based in Shrewsbury, giving you a good balance between time in the office and working from home. You'll join a friendly, collaborative finance team who work closely with colleagues right across the organisation. It's a role with genuine variety, combining day-to-day ledger work with utility analysis, and the temp to perm route gives you the chance to settle in, make your mark and secure a permanent place in the team.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous purchase ledger or accounts payable experience would be a real advantage, but it isn't essential. The role is pitched at a level that suits someone looking to build their experience, so we'd love to hear from candidates keen to learn and grow
- Experience dealing with supplier queries and reconciling supplier statements is desirable but not essential
- Good Excel skills and confidence using an accounting system
- A sound understanding of VAT on purchase invoices
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise around payment deadlines
- Clear, polite communication skills on the phone and by email
- Experience checking or reconciling utility bills is desirable but not essential

Why Join the business
- Hybrid working
- Salary of £26,000 - £28,000
- Temp to perm with a clear route to a permanent role
- Stable, well-established organisation
- Varied role spanning purchase ledger, supplier queries and utilities
- Close-knit, supportive finance team

About Us

We are a local accountancy recruitment specialist. We appreciate that roles are often online for a long period of time. If you want to check if this role is still live or just want more details before applying, call us directly.
